# Simple linear interpolation function that accepts Point3f
@inbounds function interpolated_getindex(data_3d, ranges, point::Point3f)
    x_range, y_range, z_range = ranges
    
    # Extract range parameters as Point3f for vectorized operations
    range_first = Point3f(first(x_range), first(y_range), first(z_range))
    range_step = Point3f(step(x_range), step(y_range), step(z_range))
    grid_size = Point3f(size(data_3d, 1), size(data_3d, 2), size(data_3d, 3))

    # Map coordinates to grid indices (vectorized)
    idx_float = (point .- range_first) ./ range_step .+ 1.0f0

    # Clamp to valid bounds
    idx_clamped = clamp.(idx_float, 1.0f0, grid_size)

    # Get integer and fractional parts
    idx_floor = floor.(idx_clamped)
    idx_frac = idx_clamped .- idx_floor
    
    # Convert to integer indices and clamp for array access
    idx = unsafe_trunc.(Int, idx_floor)
    idx = clamp.(idx, 1, unsafe_trunc.(Int, grid_size .- 1.0f0))
    
    x_idx, y_idx, z_idx = idx[1], idx[2], idx[3]
    x_frac, y_frac, z_frac = idx_frac[1], idx_frac[2], idx_frac[3]

    # Trilinear interpolation
    c000 = data_3d[x_idx, y_idx, z_idx]
    c100 = data_3d[x_idx+1, y_idx, z_idx]
    c010 = data_3d[x_idx, y_idx+1, z_idx]
    c110 = data_3d[x_idx+1, y_idx+1, z_idx]
    c001 = data_3d[x_idx, y_idx, z_idx+1]
    c101 = data_3d[x_idx+1, y_idx, z_idx+1]
    c011 = data_3d[x_idx, y_idx+1, z_idx+1]
    c111 = data_3d[x_idx+1, y_idx+1, z_idx+1]

    # Interpolate along x
    c00 = c000 * (1.0f0 - x_frac) + c100 * x_frac
    c01 = c001 * (1.0f0 - x_frac) + c101 * x_frac
    c10 = c010 * (1.0f0 - x_frac) + c110 * x_frac
    c11 = c011 * (1.0f0 - x_frac) + c111 * x_frac

    # Interpolate along y
    c0 = c00 * (1.0f0 - y_frac) + c10 * y_frac
    c1 = c01 * (1.0f0 - y_frac) + c11 * y_frac

    # Interpolate along z
    return c0 * (1.0f0 - z_frac) + c1 * z_frac
end

# Simple linear interpolation function that accepts Point3f
@inbounds function interpolated_getindex(data_3d, ranges, point::Point3f)
    x_range, y_range, z_range = ranges
    
    # Extract range parameters as Point3f for vectorized operations
    range_first = Point3f(first(x_range), first(y_range), first(z_range))
    range_step = Point3f(step(x_range), step(y_range), step(z_range))
    grid_size = Point3f(size(data_3d, 1), size(data_3d, 2), size(data_3d, 3))

    # Map coordinates to grid indices (vectorized)
    idx_float = (point .- range_first) ./ range_step .+ 1.0f0

    # Clamp to valid bounds
    idx_clamped = clamp.(idx_float, 1.0f0, grid_size)

    # Get integer and fractional parts
    idx_floor = floor.(idx_clamped)
    idx_frac = idx_clamped .- idx_floor
    
    # Convert to integer indices and clamp for array access
    idx = unsafe_trunc.(Int, idx_floor)
    idx = clamp.(idx, 1, unsafe_trunc.(Int, grid_size .- 1.0f0))
    
    x_idx, y_idx, z_idx = idx[1], idx[2], idx[3]
    
    # Gather 8 corner values using loop over binary offsets
    # Each corner can be indexed by (i,j,k) where i,j,k ∈ {0,1}
    corners = ntuple(8) do n
        # Binary decomposition: n-1 gives us the offset pattern
        i = (n-1) & 1        # bit 0
        j = ((n-1) >> 1) & 1 # bit 1
        k = ((n-1) >> 2) & 1 # bit 2
        data_3d[x_idx + i, y_idx + j, z_idx + k]
    end
    
    # Trilinear interpolation using the corners
    # c[i,j,k] = corners[1 + i + 2j + 4k]
    # Interpolate along x (collapse i dimension)
    wx = idx_frac[1]
    c_x = ntuple(4) do n
        j = (n-1) & 1
        k = ((n-1) >> 1) & 1
        c0 = corners[1 + 0 + 2j + 4k]  # i=0
        c1 = corners[1 + 1 + 2j + 4k]  # i=1
        c0 * (1.0f0 - wx) + c1 * wx
    end
    
    # Interpolate along y (collapse j dimension)
    wy = idx_frac[2]
    c_xy = ntuple(2) do n
        k = n - 1
        c0 = c_x[1 + 0 + 2k]  # j=0
        c1 = c_x[1 + 1 + 2k]  # j=1
        c0 * (1.0f0 - wy) + c1 * wy
    end
    
    # Interpolate along z (final scalar result)
    wz = idx_frac[3]
    return c_xy[1] * (1.0f0 - wz) + c_xy[2] * wz
end
